thread: Want to study in China on a full scholarship? Here's how the Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) works, and why your HSK level can matter. 🧵 #StudyInChina #HSK

2/ What it can cover: tuition, on-campus housing, medical insurance and a monthly stipend.

One example: Central South University's 2026–27 programme lists CNY 3,000 a month for master's students and CNY 3,500 for doctoral students.

3/ Two main routes.

Type A: you apply through the Chinese embassy or another dispatching authority in your country.

Type B: you apply to a Chinese university, starting on campuschina.org.

Deadlines vary, so check early.

4/ Language: Chinese-taught master's and PhD programmes often ask for HSK 4. English-taught ones may ask for IELTS 6 or TOEFL 85.

Common age limits: under 35 for a master's, under 40 for a PhD. Always read your university's own notice.
